notes: Both arms received clomifene citrate; the randomized additions were placebo or metformin 850 mg two times a day all ovulatory cycle for three trials maximum. The source prints only ovulation percentages (62.5% metformin; 37.5% placebo), with 32 women equally allocated overall. It does not print arm-specific event counts or numeric denominators. Served events 10 and 6 and denominators 16 and 16 require calculation and are therefore not extracted.
